progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on F in Chaharpare. Chaharmezrab (0:30.1) introduces Eb, centred on F. The line peaks at F4 (363.5 Hz) at 0:39.9. It closes on Dk4, not the tonic (F4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4).
